strings.name: Chloé Zhao
strings.summary: Raised in Beijing and educated abroad, Zhao trained in film in New York. She blends fiction with lived experience, landscapes and nonprofessional performers. The Rider and Nomadland explore marginalized American lives; the latter earned her an Oscar for directing. Eternals and Hamnet extended her work into blockbuster production and literary adaptation.

strings.influence.rationale: The Rider and Nomadland combine nonprofessional performance with documentary observation, expanding cross-cultural auteur cinema.
